component.name: spring-ai-vector-store
component.title: Spring AI Vector Store
component.description: Store, delete and search documents in a vector database with Spring AI.
component.label: ai

configuration.description: The configuration that the endpoints start from. Each endpoint uses a copy, so its own options replace the options of this configuration.

filterExpression.description: The filter on the metadata of the documents for SIMILARITY_SEARCH, in the portable filter expression syntax of Spring AI, for example country == 'UK' && year >= 2020. The CamelSpringAiVectorStoreFilterExpression header replaces this option. DELETE does not delete by filter.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

operation.description: The operation that the producer performs: ADD adds documents, which the vector store embeds; UPSERT writes documents with their vectors as they are, and replaces a document with the same id; DELETE deletes documents by id; SIMILARITY_SEARCH finds the documents most similar to a query. The CamelSpringAiVectorStoreOperation header replaces this option.

searchByVector.description: Whether SIMILARITY_SEARCH of a float[] body, such as the vector of spring-ai-embeddings, searches with this vector. By default it searches for the text of the CamelSpringAiEmbeddingInputText header, which the vector store embeds again. The vector store must support the search with a vector, and the vector must come from the same embedding model as the stored vectors.

similarityThreshold.description: The minimum similarity score, from 0 to 1, of the documents that SIMILARITY_SEARCH returns. The default 0.0 accepts all documents. The CamelSpringAiVectorStoreSimilarityThreshold header replaces this option.

topK.description: The maximum number of documents that SIMILARITY_SEARCH returns. The value must not be negative. The CamelSpringAiVectorStoreTopK header replaces this option.

vectorStore.description: The Spring AI org.springframework.ai.vectorstore.VectorStore that the producer uses, such as a Qdrant or PGvector vector store. For ADD and for SIMILARITY_SEARCH of a text, the vector store embeds the text with its own embedding model.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

CamelSpringAiVectorStoreOperation.description: The operation that the producer performs. It replaces the operation option.

CamelSpringAiVectorStoreTopK.description: The maximum number of documents that SIMILARITY_SEARCH returns. It replaces the topK option.

CamelSpringAiVectorStoreSimilarityThresh.description: The minimum similarity score, from 0 to 1, of the documents that SIMILARITY_SEARCH returns. It replaces the similarityThreshold option.

CamelSpringAiVectorStoreFilterExpression.description: The filter on the metadata of the documents for SIMILARITY_SEARCH, in the portable filter expression syntax of Spring AI. It replaces the filterExpression option.

CamelSpringAiVectorStoreUpsertDocumentId.description: The id of the document that UPSERT writes from a float[] body: the document with this id is replaced. Without it, the document gets a random UUID
The ids of the documents that UPSERT writes from a List of float[] body, one per vector: the documents with these ids are replaced. Without it, each document gets a random UUID

CamelSpringAiVectorStoreDocumentIds.description: The ids of the documents that ADD or UPSERT wrote, or that SIMILARITY_SEARCH found. DELETE reads the ids to delete from this header when the message has no body.

CamelSpringAiVectorStoreSimilarDocuments.description: The documents that SIMILARITY_SEARCH found. The message body holds the same List.

CamelSpringAiVectorStoreDocumentsAdded.description: Number of documents added by ADD, or written by UPSERT

CamelSpringAiVectorStoreDocumentsDeleted.description: Number of document IDs that DELETE gave to the vector store, as the vector store does not tell how many of them existed

producerIn.description: ADD takes a Document, a List of Document or of texts, or text (another body is added as its text); a List with another element fails. After spring-ai-embeddings it adds the float[] (or List of float[]) body with the text of the CamelSpringAiEmbeddingInputText(s) header, and a vector without its text fails. DELETE takes the id, a Document, or a List of ids or Documents (such as the result of SIMILARITY_SEARCH); the CamelSpringAiVectorStoreDocumentIds header is used only without a body. SIMILARITY_SEARCH takes the query text, or after spring-ai-embeddings the float[] body with the CamelSpringAiEmbeddingInputText header, or the float[] alone with searchByVector. UPSERT writes the float[] (or List of float[]) body of spring-ai-embeddings as it is, with the text of the CamelSpringAiEmbeddingInputText(s) header, or takes an EmbeddedDocument or a List of EmbeddedDocument. Otherwise no body fails. The CamelSpringAiVectorStoreOperation header overrides operation

producerOut.description: SIMILARITY_SEARCH gives the List of Document found. ADD, UPSERT and DELETE keep the body, with the ids and the count in headers

storeId.description: A name that identifies the endpoint. The component does not use it otherwise, so endpoints with different names can use different options for the same vector store.
